date_note: Snapshot observation date from the demo, not a September 30 recheck of business facts. Local signals are AICV observations; current conditions require confirmation. Numeric demo fit scores are intentionally not imported.

records.name: Acrisure Arena
records.summary: The Coachella Valley's first major professional sports and entertainment venue and home of the Coachella Valley Firebirds.
records.agentSignal: A large-format evening anchor for executive groups and a strong quality-of-life signal for relocating teams.
records.localSignal: Use it to test whether a relocating team can find major-event energy without driving to Los Angeles; it is a regional evening anchor, not a walkable Palm Desert stop.
records.constraints: Event-dependent; confirm the calendar before routing a group.

records.name: Bighorn Golf Club
records.summary: Ultra-private, member-owned residential golf community set above the valley floor with two championship courses.
records.agentSignal: A high-privacy residential and relationship network for principals evaluating the luxury corridor.
records.localSignal: Treat Bighorn as evidence of Palm Desert's private wealth and relationship layer, not as a place an agent can casually recommend without a host.
records.constraints: Private, residency-linked access; not a general-public venue.

records.name: Cook Street / University Row
records.summary: The connector between Highway 111 and North Palm Desert, linking university campuses, the ERC, and the city's live-work-play vision.
records.agentSignal: AICV's first routing choice for founders evaluating a satellite presence or investment in the local innovation layer.
records.localSignal: On the ground, this reads more clearly as a chain of institutional anchors than as a finished innovation district; drive the corridor end to end before judging it.
records.constraints: The corridor has institutional assets but no single active innovation-district operator.

records.name: Desert Willow Golf Resort
records.summary: Palm Desert's city-owned championship golf and event facility, positioned between private clubs and commercial hotels.
records.agentSignal: The accessible golf and event anchor when a group needs a Palm Desert experience without private-club access.
records.localSignal: The city-owned format makes Desert Willow one of the clearest places to compare public access with Palm Desert's private-club culture.
records.constraints: Tee times and event capacity are seasonal; verify live availability.

records.name: Education Corridor
records.summary: Palm Desert's concentration of higher-education institutions anchoring the Coachella Valley's workforce and AI pipeline.
records.agentSignal: The human-capital layer for founders testing hiring, training, partnerships, or long-term regional presence.
records.localSignal: Do not route to the Education Corridor as if it were a campus. Use it to understand the geography, then choose a specific institution and confirmed contact.
records.constraints: Partnership pathways vary by institution and require direct confirmation.

records.name: El Paseo
records.summary: A nine-block luxury shopping, dining, and gallery district with more than 300 businesses.
records.agentSignal: The daily-life and client-entertainment test for founders evaluating Palm Desert beyond resort walls.
records.localSignal: Don't evaluate El Paseo only as luxury retail. It is also a useful test of whether Palm Desert works for informal meetings, coffee, client hosting, and day-to-day founder life.
records.constraints: Activity is highly seasonal; individual merchants control their own hours and booking paths.

records.name: Hotel Paseo, Autograph Collection
records.summary: A 150-room boutique hotel one block from El Paseo with meeting capacity for up to 300 guests.
records.agentSignal: The default boutique accommodation anchor for an El Paseo-centered scouting trip or executive retreat.
records.localSignal: Its scouting value is proximity: a team can use the boutique-scale property as a base and step into El Paseo instead of learning Palm Desert only from inside a resort.
records.constraints: Live room, meeting, and rate availability must be verified with Marriott or the property.

records.name: JW Marriott Desert Springs Resort & Spa
records.summary: A 450-acre full-service resort with two golf courses, extensive meeting space, tennis, spa, and resort infrastructure.
records.agentSignal: The first call for large-scale corporate retreats that need conference infrastructure in Palm Desert.
records.localSignal: Use it when logistics need to disappear into one property, but pair it with an off-resort stop or the group may learn very little about everyday Palm Desert.
records.constraints: Large resort format; it is less useful for founders prioritizing a walkable, neighborhood-scale test.

records.name: McCallum Theatre
records.summary: The Coachella Valley's primary performing-arts venue, presenting Broadway, classical, jazz, comedy, and dance in a 1,127-seat hall.
records.agentSignal: A cultural-quality anchor for evaluating the valley as a place to retain executives and host evening programming.
records.localSignal: The McCallum helps answer the relocation question 'What would we actually do on a weeknight?'—but only when the performance calendar is active.
records.constraints: The main performance season runs primarily during the cooler months.

records.name: North Palm Desert Development Zone
records.summary: A 400-plus-acre growth frontier around the university campuses and I-10, targeted for housing, infrastructure, and commercial expansion.
records.agentSignal: The strongest physical growth container for a founder moving from scouting to site selection.
records.localSignal: The scale is easiest to understand from Cook Street and I-10, but pair the drive with a city briefing because much of the signal is future-facing.
records.constraints: AICV notes active public investment but no active AI or innovation programming in the zone itself.

records.name: Palm Desert Economic Development
records.summary: The city's economic-development infrastructure, special projects, and business-recruitment resources.
records.agentSignal: The civic handoff for incentives, city processes, recruitment resources, and official development conversations.
records.localSignal: Arrive with a defined site, timeline, jobs question, or permitting issue; without a concrete decision, the conversation is likely to remain general.
records.constraints: Treat this as a routing node; current programs and eligibility require city confirmation.

records.name: The Gardens on El Paseo
records.summary: An open-air luxury retail and dining destination anchoring El Paseo with flagship designer boutiques.
records.agentSignal: A concentrated test of the luxury retail, dining, and client-hosting layer within a walkable district.
records.localSignal: Use The Gardens as more than a luxury-shopping stop: it concentrates coffee, walkability, and client hosting, while its Simon ownership makes the property relevant to larger retail and technology conversations.
records.constraints: The property and individual tenants have separate digital and booking surfaces.

records.name: The Living Desert Zoo and Gardens
records.summary: A 1,200-acre zoo and botanical garden focused on desert ecosystems, wildlife conservation, and regional flora.
records.agentSignal: A family and outdoor-quality-of-life anchor that makes a scouting trip feel rooted in the desert rather than in a generic resort.
records.localSignal: This becomes a stronger relocation signal when you use it to test a family weekend routine and Palm Desert's desert identity; locals know to schedule around the heat.
records.constraints: Outdoor conditions and seasonal temperatures should shape visit timing.

records.name: CSUSB Palm Desert Campus
records.summary: A university anchor on Cook Street and part of the institutional base for entrepreneurship and workforce programming in Palm Desert.
records.agentSignal: Relevant to university partnerships, entrepreneurship programming, and the founder-economy thesis around Cook Street.
records.localSignal: The campus matters through specific introductions and programs, not a generic drive-by tour; pair it with a Cook Street corridor orientation.
records.constraints: Program and partnership availability must be confirmed with the campus.

records.name: UCR Palm Desert Center
records.summary: A University of California institutional presence in the Cook Street education and innovation corridor.
records.agentSignal: A potential research, extension, and regional partnership touchpoint for incoming founders.
records.localSignal: Treat UCR as a relationship node whose value appears through the right program or contact, not as an open-ended drop-in destination.
records.constraints: Specific programs and access vary; verify directly with UCR.

records.name: College of the Desert
records.summary: The region's community-college anchor and a core part of Palm Desert's education and workforce corridor.
records.agentSignal: Relevant to practical workforce pathways, training partnerships, and long-term talent development.
records.localSignal: College of the Desert is most useful when the founder brings a named workforce or training need instead of asking for a general campus overview.
records.constraints: Workforce partnership scope requires direct institutional confirmation.

records.name: Entrepreneurship Resource Center
records.summary: A city-supported small-business center at 37023 Cook Street that also houses AICV's office and sustained AI workshop programming.
records.agentSignal: For active AI workshops and founder office hours, route to AICV-operated programming at this address—not to the ERC as an independently resourced ecosystem operator.
records.localSignal: AICV operates workshops and founder programming here, which makes this one of the places where Palm Desert's emerging AI community is actually visible in person. Visit only around a confirmed program or introduction.
records.constraints: AICV documents institutional strain and warns against treating the ERC itself as an active, well-resourced founder destination; verify current status before travel.

records.name: The Shops at Palm Desert
records.summary: A major commercial property and redevelopment signal along the Highway 111 corridor, with mixed-use planning work documented by AICV.
records.agentSignal: A live case study for commercial repositioning and the city's evolving development path.
records.localSignal: Visit to understand a property in transition, not for a polished retail experience; the gap between today's center and the redevelopment vision is the useful signal.
records.constraints: Redevelopment status is time-sensitive; use the latest AICV brief and verify with the city or owner.
records.sourceType: City of Palm Desert current listing; AICV-cited entity

records.name: Rutina Coffee
records.summary: A boutique coffee shop on San Pablo Avenue built around specialty coffee, matcha, design, and community connection.
records.agentSignal: A routeable informal meeting stop and useful entry point for evaluating the emerging San Pablo corridor.
records.localSignal: One of AICV's preferred meeting stops: a quieter setting than some busier nearby cafes, with thoughtful coffee and matcha options that make it easy to have an actual conversation.
records.constraints: Hours, seating, and peak-time noise are live conditions; confirm before routing a time-sensitive meeting.

records.name: Sottovoce Cafe at The Gardens
records.summary: An Italian-style coffee and wine bar on the lower level of The Gardens on El Paseo.
records.agentSignal: A calm El Paseo meeting option for testing coffee, conversation, and client-hosting life within the district.
records.localSignal: Sottovoce works particularly well when you want good coffee and enough calm to actually have a conversation; it also gives a close-up view of The Gardens as an evolving property signal.
records.constraints: Seating and atmosphere vary by time of day; verify current hours and allow for seasonal El Paseo traffic.

records.name: Hotel Paseo Lobby + Cafe Paseo
records.summary: A relaxed lobby and cafe setting at Hotel Paseo with communal seating, coffee, quick bites, and immediate access to El Paseo.
records.agentSignal: A low-friction place to meet before or after an El Paseo scouting stop without booking a formal workspace.
records.localSignal: The in-house coffee operation has changed over time, but the lobby remains an easy, comfortable and under-the-radar place to sit down with someone.
records.constraints: This is an informal hotel-lobby option, not a reservable coworking space; confirm current cafe service and respect guest activity.

records.name: Bump and Grind Trail
records.summary: A popular Palm Desert-area mountain trail used for a compact workout and broad views across the city and Coachella Valley.
records.agentSignal: The clearest routeable outdoor stop for testing whether desert fitness, terrain, and landscape belong in a founder's weekly life.
records.localSignal: This is AICV's outdoor anchor: a regular local hike that gets you away from the screen and finishes with a view across Palm Desert and the Coachella Valley from east to west.
records.constraints: Desert heat, daylight, trail conditions, parking, and physical ability matter; check current guidance and never route a midday summer hike.
